findings.issue: Borrowers are not informed they can escalate complaints to the RBI Ombudsman through the CMS portal.
findings.doc_evidence: Complaints go to a named nodal officer at the bank and at Sakhi Digital. If a complaint is rejected, the app tells the borrower the decision is final; borrowers are not told they can escalate to the RBI Ombudsman through the CMS portal.

findings.issue: Borrowers are not asked before their personal data is shared with an insurance company.
findings.doc_evidence: Members' names, phone numbers and loan amounts are sent to an insurance company so it can call them with micro-insurance offers. Borrowers are not asked before this is shared.

findings.issue: Sakhi Digital has no privacy policy on its website.
findings.doc_evidence: Sakhi Digital has no privacy policy on its website; it plans to publish one next year.

findings.issue: Repayment is executed through the RE’s bank account, but the document does not specify that the repayment is directly from the borrower’s account.
findings.doc_evidence: Weekly repayments go directly from the member's bank account to Godavari SFB by UPI autopay.

findings.issue: The app requests one-time location access during onboarding to verify the business address, but the privacy policy is not disclosed.
findings.doc_evidence: The app requests one-time location access during onboarding to verify the business address, with consent.
